sources.source: Federal Reserve Board H.10 Data Download Program

note: Only the exact H.10 Nominal Broad Dollar Index raw-series tuple is metadata-qualified here. Every observation still requires an evidence_manifest_id, a manifest bound to the exact row metadata, and independently rehashed raw payload bytes. This series is not ICE DXY and is not the H.10 bilateral USD/INR series. Do not map it to dxy_change_pct_20d without a separately tested derivation and explicit naming.
